name: Wolves

variantInfo.name: Wolf
notes: The level-25 Wolf (npc 110) on White Wolf Mountain has 20 Hitpoints, max hit 3 (stab), a 4-tick attack and gives 34 Slayer XP; it is the representative default.
Other wolf levels also count: level 11 (10 HP, 10 XP), level 14 (10 HP, 15 XP) and level 64 (52 HP, 69 XP).

variantInfo.name: White wolf
notes: White wolves (npcs 107-108) have 34 Hitpoints, max hit 3 (stab), Defence 22 and give 34 Slayer XP.

variantInfo.name: Big wolf
notes: Big wolves (npcs 109/115) have 74 Hitpoints, max hit 7 (stab), Defence 62 and give 74 Slayer XP; they are the toughest wolf variant.

locationComparison.name: White Wolf Mountain
notes: White Wolf Mountain (between Taverley and Catherby) has a dense pack of wolves, white wolves and big wolves.
The Slayer_task/Wolves location table lists White Wolf Mountain as 6 spawns, multicombat, cannonable and safespottable.
A Dwarf multicannon can be used here.

taskNotes: Wolves are assigned by Turael, Spria and Mazchna (Turael/Spria 15-30, Mazchna 30-50; weight 7 each).
A combat level of 20 is required to be assigned wolves (mapped to combatLevel).
slayerTargetId 305 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.

Wolves have a 25% weakness to fire spells (20% for Big wolves, added 25 June 2025); their melee/ranged Defence bonuses are all +0, so any weapon is accurate but fire magic exploits the elemental weakness.
Representative variants authored: Wolf (level 25, default), White wolf (level 25) and Big wolf (level 73). Other wolf levels (11/14/64) count and are documented in variantInfo/notes.
No required protective item and no task extension unlock exist for Wolves.
recommendedMethod: A fast starter task once you reach combat level 20: kill the wolves on White Wolf Mountain between Taverley and Catherby. Their Defence bonuses are all +0 so any melee weapon lands reliably; fire spells (Fire Strike/Bolt/Blast) exploit the 25% fire weakness if you are training Magic. Bring a little food for the level-64 and Big wolf variants.
